snippet.title: Skillshot City Trailer - The Free Battle Royale With Roguelite Superpowers
snippet.description:
Play for free on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/308600/Skillshot_City

Skillshot City is a chaotic battle royale with roguelite superpowers and infinite revives. Loot, shoot, cast and drive through a GTA-style city to level up wild skills and create clever combos. If you die, keep fighting outside the circle and try to revive before the final showdown!
